title: Competitive-like binding between carbon black and CTNNB1 to DeltaNp63 interpreting the abnormal respiratory epithelial repair after injury.
authors: Wei, Xiaoran; Liu, Nan; Feng, Yawen; Wang, Hongmei; Han, Weizhong; Zhuang, Min; Zhang, Hongna; Gao, Wei; Lin, Yongfeng; Tang, Xiaowen; Zheng, Yuxin
journal: The Science of the total environment
one_liner_zh: 该文研究碳黑纳米颗粒与CTNNB1竞争性结合DeltaNp63蛋白，通过分子动力学模拟揭示其干扰蛋白-DNA/蛋白互作并影响呼吸道上皮修复，属广义蛋白-DNA互作体系且含物理模拟方法，但非典型TF-DNA转录结合体系，故评6分。
abstract: Airway epithelium is extraordinary vulnerable to damage owning to continuous environment exposure. Subsequent repair is therefore essential to restore the homeostasis of respiratory system. Disruptions in respiratory epithelial repair caused by nanoparticles exposure have been linked to various human diseases, yet implications in repair process remain incompletely elucidated. This study aims to elucidate the key stage in epithelial repair disturbed by carbon black (CB) nanoparticles, highlighting the pivotal role of DeltaNp63 in mediating the epithelium repair. A competitive-like binding between CB and beta-catenin 1 (CTNNB1) to DeltaNp63 is proposed to elaborate the underlying toxicity mechanism. Specifically, CB exhibits a remarkable inhibitory effect on cell proliferation, leading to aberrant airway epithelial repair, as validated in air-liquid culture. DeltaNp63 drives efficient epithelial proliferation during CB exposure, and CTNNB1 was identified as a target of DeltaNp63 by bioinformatics analysis. Further molecular dynamics simulation reveals that oxygen-containing functional groups on CB disrupt the native interaction of CTNNB1 with DeltaNp63 through competitive-like binding pattern. This process modulates CTNNB1 expression, ultimately restraining proliferation during respiratory epithelial repair. Overall, the current study elucidates that the diminished interaction between CTNNB1 and DeltaNp63 impedes respiratory epithelial repair in response to CB exposure, thereby enriching the public health risk assessment on CB-related respiratory diseases.
abstract_zh: 气道上皮因持续暴露于环境而极易受损，因此后续修复对于恢复呼吸系统稳态至关重要。纳米颗粒暴露引起的呼吸道上皮修复紊乱与多种人类疾病相关，但其在修复过程中的影响尚未完全阐明。本研究旨在阐明炭黑（carbon black, CB）纳米颗粒干扰上皮修复的关键阶段，强调DeltaNp63在介导上皮修复中的关键作用。提出CB与β-连环蛋白1（CTNNB1）对DeltaNp63的竞争性结合样模式，以阐述其潜在毒性机制。具体而言，CB对细胞增殖表现出显著抑制作用，导致气道上皮修复异常，这一现象在气-液培养中得到验证。DeltaNp63在CB暴露期间驱动高效上皮增殖，并通过生物信息学分析确定CTNNB1为DeltaNp63的靶标。进一步的分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟揭示，CB上的含氧官能团通过竞争性结合样模式破坏CTNNB1与DeltaNp63的天然相互作用。该过程调节CTNNB1表达，最终抑制呼吸道上皮修复过程中的增殖。总体而言，本研究阐明CTNNB1与DeltaNp63之间相互作用的减弱阻碍了CB暴露下的呼吸道上皮修复，从而丰富了CB相关呼吸道疾病的公共卫生风险评估。
